CONJECTURE — not machine-verified

Machine-checked: logical validity given the stated model. NOT an empirical validation of the model's assumptions.

logical validity given the model, not empirical validation of its assumptions

Historical description (verification assertions below are not current certification labels):

Three machine-checked Lean 4 theorems on connectivity-weighted conservation budgeting, derived as an application of the Viridis Intelligence Bound (dI/dt ≤ P·D/(k_B T ln 2)). equimarginal_of_optimal (KKT/equimarginal first-order optimality), strictConcave_unique_max (uniqueness of the maximizer under strict concavity), and linear_regime_corner (linear-yield regime forces a full-enrollment corner optimum). Verified by the Aristotle (Harmonic) automated proving system: zero sorry; axiom audit limited to {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; Lean toolchain v4.28.0; Mathlib pin 8f9d9cff. Aristotle project 452756cd-9b51-4bb7-9c43-e6b7365d2457. The proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Part of the Viridis canon; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982.
